name: order_lookup
description: Look up an order by customer ID and product ID, returning its status and purchase date.

inputSchema.description: Input for looking up an order in the workshop-orders table.

customer_id.description: The unique identifier of the customer who placed the order, e.g. C-01.

product_id.description: The unique identifier of the ordered product, e.g. P-001.

name: user_lookup
description: Look up a customer's profile by customer ID, returning their name and country code.

inputSchema.description: Input for looking up a customer in the workshop-customers table.

customer_id.description: The unique identifier of the customer, e.g. C-01.

name: product_lookup
description: Look up a product by product ID, returning its name, category, and provider.

inputSchema.description: Input for looking up a product in the workshop-products table.

product_id.description: The unique identifier of the product, e.g. P-001.
